given: a known SKU that currently holds no stock at any location
when: the warehouse team member opens that SKU's detail view
then: an explicit "No stock" state is shown for the SKU instead of a blank page

independence.rationale: AC1-AC3 concern a SKU that has stock and its optional detail; AC4 concerns the disjoint case of a known SKU with zero stock records, asserting an explicit empty state rather than a blank page. This empty state can be missing while populated SKUs render correctly, so it fails independently.

architectural_notes: E2E: the empty-result branch of the detail read path for a KNOWN sku, the repository query returns an empty set of stock_records, the boundary returns an empty JSON collection (200, not 404), and the service distinguishes "known sku, zero stock" from "unknown sku" (AC5). The React component maps the known-empty case to an explicit "No stock" state. Cross-cutting: known-vs-unknown and empty-vs-error semantics owned by the service. Verified real-branch (NFR-F1-4): with a known sku but no stock rows seeded, assert the "No stock" state renders instead of a blank page.
